digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and route registry
propositions: Hand-maintained help artifacts are stale and drift from true runtime parser grammar; generated help must be authoritative and deterministic.
The pre-scan lexical routing for help and unknown commands must complete before operation composition, config parsing, store mount, or optional imports.
Every visible canonical command must appear exactly once in the grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes and compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow approved annotation rules.
Generator --check mode must fail on missing/stale/stray artifacts, non-deterministic renders, blank parser summaries, or registry/parser census mismatch.
Factory enrichment in core and advanced parsers must replace hand-authored usage/option tables with per-argument help= and description/epilog text.
All generated help artifacts preserve the capitalized 'Usage:' prefix byte-for-byte; runtime help is served from committed generated txt before any boundary.
